template: Goal / Context / Acceptance criteria / Scope & non-goals / Execution hints.
rules: Front-load context: file paths, function names, and conventions the executor cannot infer.
State acceptance criteria as checkable items, not vibes.
Explicitly list out-of-scope work — SWE-2 is proactive and will expand otherwise.
Mention test commands and verification gates verbatim.
Reference existing code conventions to mimic, not restyle.
do: Cite concrete file paths and prior commits as anchors.
Say 'verify with tools' for claims that must be checked, not assumed.
Keep instructions telegraphic — dense beats verbose.
dont: Do not leave scope ambiguous; every unchecked edge becomes scope creep.
Do not request comments, docs, or refactors not asked for.
Do not bury the acceptance criteria — they are the contract.
